steps.headline: Weimar: fragmented green recovery amid permanent climate scars
steps.outlook: Weimar survives climate chaos through radical green densification and river healing, but lost its old forest canopy and never fully recovered it—a transformed, smaller, greener, but forever changed town.

observed.pattern: Young people plant gardens in paved squares; old trees still scarce; river much cleaner; heating zero-carbon; cars rare in core
observed.assumption: Adaptation beats mitigation: Weimar survives by radical downsizing, radical green infill, and river restoration; but old tree canopy lost for generations

changes.title: Retrofitted, dark buildings livened
changes.story: Empty buildings repurposed as co-housing; exteriors painted bright; roofs solar+green; shared courtyards filled with gardens

changes.title: River Ilm restored ecosystem
changes.story: Decades of cleanup and bank rewilding; native fish return; otters seen; water level stable from rain harvesting
